one_line_answer.text: Your workplace may have emergency equipment, like fire extinguishers and stretchers.

cites.quote: Your workplace may have emergency equipment available, including:

bangla_explanation: Emergency procedure-এর দুটি অংশ: emergency plan আর emergency equipment।
কর্মস্থলে fire extinguishers, fire blankets, stretchers, flashlights, spill kits, eyewash stations and showers থাকতে পারে।
কিন্তু fire extinguisher বা অন্য emergency equipment ব্যবহারের আগে proper use-এ trained হতে হবে।
আগে থেকে জেনে রাখুন: emergency exits কোথায়, fire alarms কোথায়, first aid কোথায়।

example.en: A polytechnic chemistry lab keeps spill kits near the door. It also has eyewash stations and showers.
example.bn: Polytechnic-এর chemistry lab-এ দরজার পাশে spill kit আর eyewash station রাখা থাকে।

list_answer.title: Emergency equipment your workplace may have
list_answer.title_bn: কর্মস্থলে যে emergency equipment থাকতে পারে
items_bn: Fire extinguishers — ছোট আগুন নেভানোর যন্ত্র; ব্যবহারের আগে training লাগে।
Fire blankets — আগুন চাপা দিয়ে নেভানোর কম্বল।
Stretchers — আহত মানুষকে বহন করার জন্য।
Flashlights — বিদ্যুৎ চলে গেলে পথ দেখার জন্য টর্চ।
Spill kits — বিপজ্জনক কিছু ছড়িয়ে পড়লে পরিষ্কারের কিট।
Eyewash stations and showers — চোখে বা গায়ে কিছু পড়লে দ্রুত ধোয়ার জন্য।

traps.text: Before using a fire extinguisher, make sure you're trained on its proper use.

cites.quote: Before using a fire extinguisher or other emergency equipment, make sure you're trained on its proper use.

traps.text: The emergency procedure includes an emergency plan and emergency equipment.

cites.quote: The procedure will include an emergency plan and emergency equipment.

traps.text: Some jobs have emergency eye wash stations or showers. Make sure you're shown how to use them.

cites.quote: Some jobs may also have facilities to deal with emergencies. They could include emergency eye wash stations or showers.
Make sure you're shown when and how to use them.

short.prompt: What emergency equipment may your workplace have? How can you be prepared?
short.modelAnswer:
Emergency equipment may include:
1. Fire extinguishers
2. Fire blankets
3. Stretchers
4. Flashlights
5. Spill kits
6. Eyewash stations and showers
Be prepared: know where the emergency exits, fire alarms, fire extinguishers and first aid are. Get trained before using the equipment.
